name: io.github.davidmosiah/rappi-mcp
description: Unofficial local-first Rappi MCP: search stores/products, inspect cart, list addresses and track orders. Checkout is fail-closed.

environmentVariables.name: RAPPI_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal Rappi consumer access token. Prefer `rappi-mcp-unofficial auth --token` so this never sits in client config.

environmentVariables.name: RAPPI_ALLOW_MUTATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Set true to allow cart writes and place-order. Default false (never pays).

environmentVariables.name: RAPPI_COUNTRY
environmentVariables.description: ISO country code for unofficial consumer base URL. Default BR.

environmentVariables.name: RAPPI_PRIVACY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: summary | structured | raw. Default structured (redacts street/phone/email/last-four).
